codelab: initial commit This commit introduces a small ChromeOS codelab. After completing this codelab, users should know how to: * mark a package for development (cros_workon), * make changes to source and build a binary (emerge), * run unit tests, * and deploy the binary to a chromebook with a test image. These steps are documented in the developer guide today, but by adding concrete documentation and steps, readers have a simple example to work on and are free to experiment. libbrillo, mist: move Udev to static factory construction The two-step construct-then-initialize means that we may have partially initialized objects lying around, which aren't useful. It also potentially opens up bugs where the udev context is null but we pass it into udev library functions anyway. Make this harder to get wrong by combining the construction steps into one, so a Udev object always has a valid udev context. Then move to the new version of this in mist. CHROMIUM: iwl7000: mvm: disable TX-AMSDU on older NICs On older NICs, we occasionally see issues with A-MSDU support, where the commands in the FIFO get confused and then we see an assert EDC because the next command in the FIFO isn't TX. We've tried to isolate this issue and understand where it comes from, but haven't found any errors in building the A-MSDU in software. At least for now, disable A-MSDU support on older hardware so that users can use it again without fearing the assert. This fixes https://bugzilla.kernel.org/show_bug.cgi?id=203315.
